newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Jilin Electric mulls listing overseas.
newsitem.headline: China's Jilin Electric mulls listing overseas.

text.p: China's Jilin Electric Power Co Ltd plans to issue 300 million foreign currency shares abroad to raise funds for the construction of new domestic power plants, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.

The firm, based in Changchun, capital of northeastern Jilin province, has yet to decide whether to list the shares in Tokyo or Hong Kong, the spokesman told the China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter.
He gave no timetable for the planned issue.
It was among 38 domestic enterprises selected by the Securities Commission of the State Council, or the cabinet, recently as candidates for overseas listing.
The firm was in the process of selecting an underwriter for the offer, the spokesman said.
The company has stakes in six power plants in China with combined capacity of 800 megawatts and capable of supplying four billion kw-hour of electricity annually.
